name: Secret Cenote
alt: Entering the Secret Cenote through the cave in Tulum
oneline: A cenote not even locals know about. The entrance is an ancient well created by the Maya. A great option for gender diverse people who want to feel completely at ease in their bathing suit.
body:
You'll climb down a ladder through the well, down into a private cenote. The family who cares for this land has created a botanical garden from the plants they find on their adventures in the jungle. If this is a private tour, there's an option to skinny dip.

We get the cenote all to ourselves, and it's shaded from the sun. The owners are careful to give each group private time.

4-5 hours Underground cenote Local Maya family Swimming

Optional add-on: visit a local cenote with cliff jumping, perfect for swimming and amazing snorkeling. +700 MXN per person, about $40 USD.

Itinerary

  • Meet at a cafe in Tulum town
  • ~20-30 min drive to the cenotes
  • Optional add-on: local favorite open cenote (cliff jumping)
  • Secret Cave Cenote
  • Picnic at the cenote
  • Drive back

Included

  • Round-trip transport from the cafe
  • Professional guide
  • Entrance fees
  • Life jackets & snorkels
  • Picnic with traditional Mexican and healthy regional snacks

Not included

  • Hotel pickup/drop-off (available on request)

Optional add-on: taco breakfast. +300 MXN per group, about $18 USD.
seoDescription: A private cave cenote near Tulum, reached by ladder through an ancient Maya well. Queer-led, shaded from the sun, and private to your group.

name: Muyil River Float
alt: Group floating the Muyil River through mangroves and canals
oneline: The most relaxing day in Tulum, boating through lagoons and mangroves.
body:
Relaxation tour. Float through canals built by the ancient Maya. It's the one people keep talking about long after they get home. Bring nothing but yourself. The water does the rest.

4.5-5.5 hours Ancient Mayan canals Mangroves & lagoons Floating

Itinerary

  • Meet at Story Horse Cafe in the morning
  • ~20-30 min drive to Muyil
  • Float the ancient Mayan canals
  • Boat through the lagoons and mangroves
  • Picnic by the lagoon
  • Drive back

Included

  • Round-trip transport from the cafe
  • Professional guide
  • Entrance fees
  • Life jackets
  • Picnic with traditional Mexican and healthy regional snacks

Not included

  • Hotel pickup/drop-off (available on request)

Optional add-on: taco breakfast. +300 MXN per group, about $18 USD.
seoTitle: Muyil River Float Tour in Tulum
seoDescription: Float canals built by the ancient Maya and boat through lagoons and mangroves near Tulum on a relaxing, queer-led day tour. Bring nothing but yourself.

name: Intro to Cenotes Tour
alt: Friends laughing together at an open cenote on the Intro to Cenotes Tour in Tulum
oneline: Two off-the-beaten-path cenotes, cave and open water.
body:
Taak Bi Ha is an amazing cave cenote, a cenote in the jungle with great lighting for swimming and stalactite and stalagmite formations. Nicte Ha is a fully open cenote with lily pads, cliff jumping, and amazing snorkeling.

4-5 hours Cave & open cenote Cliff jumping Swimming

Itinerary

  • Meet at a cafe in Tulum town
  • ~20-30 min drive to the cenotes
  • Taak Bi Ha cave cenote
  • Nicte Ha open cenote
  • Drive back

Included

  • Professional guide
  • Entrance fees
  • Life jackets & snorkels
  • Picnic with traditional Mexican and healthy regional snacks

Not included

Optional add-on: taco breakfast. +300 MXN per group, about $18 USD.
seoTitle: Intro to Cenotes Tour in Tulum
seoDescription: Two off-the-beaten-path cenotes near Tulum, a cave cenote and an open one with cliff jumping and snorkeling, on a queer-led small-group tour.

name: Monkey Spotting + Lagoon Jungle Adventure
alt: Looking out over the lagoon at Punta Laguna on the Monkey Spotting tour
oneline: A full day in the jungle looking for wild monkeys.
body:
Along the way, enjoy swimming, canoeing, and zip lining over a pristine lagoon. And because your guide is a UCLA wildlife biologist, you'll actually understand what you're looking at, not just see it. Includes picnic lunch.

Full day Wild spider monkeys Zip line & canoe Lunch included

Itinerary

  • Meet in Tulum town
  • ~1.5 hour drive to the lagoon
  • A moment of intention with a local guide before entering the jungle
  • Walk the jungle looking for wild spider monkeys
  • Harness up and rappel into a cenote holding an underwater ancient Maya burial site
  • Zip line
  • Canoe
  • Play in the lagoon, a full picnic spread on the dock, shaded area to relax

Order can vary by day.

Included

  • UCLA wildlife biologist guide
  • Zip line & canoe
  • Picnic lunch
  • Snacks

Not included

  • Hotel pickup/drop-off

Optional add-on: taco breakfast. +300 MXN per group, about $18 USD.
seoDescription: A full day in the jungle near Tulum: wild monkeys, swimming, canoeing, and zip lining over a lagoon, led by a queer UCLA wildlife biologist.

name: Stories Behind the Storefronts
alt: A group workshop at La Guarida, a local cultural center in Tulum, on the Stories Behind the Storefronts tour
oneline: Explore the local side of Tulum. Get the chisme (gossip).
body:
Find out what it's like to live in Tulum. Eat our favorite food, and go out to the places that make people want to call this place home. This is the town behind the town, the locally-owned shops, the makers, and the people whose stories you'd never hear as a tourist passing through. We stop where the owners know us by name, explore the murals, and taste what the neighborhood actually eats. You'll leave knowing the difference between the Tulum people visit and the Tulum people live in.

3-4 hours Local shops & makers Murals Food & drinks included Walking

Sample Itinerary

  • Meet in Tulum town center
  • Share a meal together at a local restaurant
  • Explore murals around town
  • Learn local chisme (for example, Tulum as a municipality is only 17 years old)
  • Learn the nuances of Tulum's different neighborhoods (La Veleta, Cancha Maya, Centro, Aldea Zama, Tumben Ka'a)
  • Visit Ladle, a local community center, for snacks and more

Personalized based on what your group wants to see and do. This is just a taste of what's included.

Included

  • Professional guide
  • Food and drink at the local stops
seoTitle: Stories Behind the Storefronts, Tulum Tour
seoDescription: Explore the local side of Tulum: murals, locally owned shops, and the food neighbors actually eat, on a queer-led tour full of chisme.

name: Food Tour
alt: A friend celebrating over bao buns at a Tulum restaurant on the Food Tour
oneline: Explore prehispanic Mexican food and the amazing fusions that make Tulum one of the best places to eat.
body:
We mix and match across three local spots in one tour: street stands, casual eats, and sit-down favorites.

2-3 hours Food & drinks included Mix of street food & sit-down Local spots

Itinerary

  • Meet in Tulum town
  • Three stops, mixing street food and sit-down spots
  • Transportation between stops, walking or driving depending on the day

Included

  • Food & drinks
  • Local guide
  • Transportation between stops

Not included

  • Hotel pickup/drop-off
seoTitle: Tulum Food Tour With a Queer Local
seoDescription: Prehispanic Mexican food and the fusions that make Tulum a great place to eat: three local stops, street food and sit-down, on a queer-led tour.
